changeSet.author: ttn
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE rule_definition ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), rule_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, group_code VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL CHECK (group_code IN ('FLD','DOC','XDOC','REG','ANM')), severity VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL CHECK (severity IN ('ERROR','WARNING','INFO')), entity_type VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, evaluator VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL CHECK (evaluator IN ('SPEL','SQL')), definition JSONB NOT NULL, params JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', legal_refs JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', rag_query TEXT, enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE, version INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, source_hash CHAR(64) NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), CONSTRAINT uk_rule_definition_rule_id UNIQUE (rule_id) ); CREATE TABLE review_job ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), company_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, period_from DATE NOT NULL, period_to DATE NOT NULL, scope JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', status VARCHAR(15) NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING','COMPLETED','FAILED','CANCELLED')), total_documents INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, processed_documents INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, total_batches INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, failed_batches INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, violation_count INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, requested_by UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES app_user(id), started_at TIMESTAMPTZ, finished_at TIMESTAMPTZ, error_message TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), CONSTRAINT ck_review_job_period CHECK (period_from <= period_to) ); CREATE INDEX idx_review_job_company_created ON review_job (company_id, created_at DESC);
changeSet.rollback: DROP TABLE review_job; DROP TABLE rule_definition;
